constraints.text: USER has no global landlord/tenant role; role/capability is relationship-derived.
ROOM operational state VACANT/OCCUPIED/MAINTENANCE/INACTIVE is separate from ACTIVE/ARCHIVED record lifecycle.
LISTING=PUBLISHED requires Room=VACANT and both Room/Property active; Room leaving VACANT synchronously unpublishes it.
A Room has at most one current non-archived Listing; historical archived Listings may be many.
A Room has at most one non-terminal Tenancy where non-terminal = DRAFT | ACTIVE | ENDING.
While a Tenancy is ENDING, MVP does not create the next Draft Tenancy; pre-rental interest remains Inquiry until Room is VACANT.
An active Tenancy has exactly one active PRIMARY participant and 0..N active OCCUPANT participants.
TENANCY_PARTICIPANT may link 0..1 USER and may exist before an account.
TENANCY_TERMS is versioned; each Billing Cycle keeps the applied Terms version provenance.
MVP Charge scope is RENT | ELECTRICITY | WATER only.
Each PAYMENT belongs to exactly one TENANCY.
Payment allocation/application targets must belong to the same Tenancy as the Payment.
Agreed deposit requirement belongs to TENANCY_TERMS; DEPOSIT owns fulfillment/holding/settlement.
RECEIPT is issued only from confirmed Payment; void/reissue preserves history and allows max 1 current non-voided Receipt.
Open Incident blocks Room/Property archive; archive never auto-closes an Incident.
A Trust Report targets exactly one public-content object: Listing or Review.
Inquiry is a discovery-to-rental bridge but is not a prerequisite for creating Tenancy.
Review eligibility is based on verified rental history; baseline requires ENDED tenancy and eligible linked participant.
Review targets Property/Rental Experience, not a public personal landlord/operator rating.
